# JJ & Company — Wall Fin® Paint Rollers & Panama Brushes

> JJ & Company is an official registered brand (Wall Fin®) manufacturer of professional paint rollers, roller refills, and imported Panama paint brushes based in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, India. Established in 2016, the company operates a direct manufacturing plant and wholesale distribution depo serving hardware stores, paint stockists, and painting contractors across Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.

## Core Products & Manufacturing

- **Wall Fin® Paint Rollers**: Standard 20mm and heavy 38mm core diameters with solvent-resistant polypropylene cores, zero-shed woven microfiber knits, and heavy-gauge cage frames.
  - Wall Fin® Blue Line Paint Roller (Standard 20mm & 38mm)
  - Wall Fin® Yellow Line Paint Roller (Standard 20mm & 38mm)
  - Wall Fin® Green Paint Roller & Green Thread (38mm)
  - Wall Fin® Epoxy Paint Roller (Phenolic-bonded for solvent-based epoxies)
  - Wall Fin® Foam Fix Roller (High-density foam for ultra-smooth gloss finishes)
  - Wall Fin® Tiger Paint Roller (38mm heavy pick-up exterior roller)
  - Wall Fin® Texture Roller (38mm high-deflection for rough exterior stucco)
  - Roller refills, cage handles, and extension adaptors
- **Panama Paint Brushes**: Authentic imported brush lines with 100% computerized epoxy bristle potting and stainless steel ferrules.
  - Panama CAT 100% Pure Bristol Paint Brush
  - Panama Tynex Wooden Handle Paint Brush
  - Panama Deluxe Long Hair Paint Brush
  - Panama 222, 777 PVC, 815, 996 PVC, Apex PVC, Swan, Tip-Top, and Winner Brushes
- **Surface Preparation Accessories**:
  - Maruti Auto Gloss Thinners & NC Lacquer Reducers
  - Nico Wood Polish & Natural Shellac
  - Cumi Abrasive Cut Sheets & 230mm Machine Sanding Paper
  - Precision Wooden Pata & Medium/Extra Heavy Steel Pata
